input.summary: Extend the Section 14.5 carve-outs into a defined set of Excluded Claims and add a mutual cap at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 14.5 waives indirect damages but has no monetary cap, so direct-damages exposure is unlimited both ways; we add a mutual cap at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000. Indemnification, confidentiality, data protection, security, IP, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud sit outside that cap, and Customer's payment obligations are not damages for cap purposes.

ops.oldText: NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING, NOTHING IN THIS SECTION 14.5 IS INTENDED TO OR SHALL LIMIT OR RESTRICT THE INDEMNIFICATION RIGHTS OR OBLIGATIONS OF ANY PARTY UNDER SECTION 14.1 OR SECTION 14.2, OR DAMAGES AVAILABLE FOR A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS OBLIGATIONS RELATING TO CONFIDENTIALITY UNDER ARTICLE XI OR INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY UNDER ARTICLE X.
ops.newText: NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING, NOTHING IN THIS SECTION 14.5 IS INTENDED TO OR SHALL LIMIT OR RESTRICT THE INDEMNIFICATION RIGHTS OR OBLIGATIONS OF ANY PARTY UNDER SECTION 14.1 OR SECTION 14.2, OR DAMAGES AVAILABLE FOR A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS OBLIGATIONS RELATING TO CONFIDENTIALITY UNDER ARTICLE XI, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY, OR INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY UNDER ARTICLE X, OR A PARTY'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD (COLLECTIVELY, "EXCLUDED CLAIMS").

ops.text: Except for Excluded Claims, each party's aggregate liability arising under this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000. Customer's payment obligations, and all amounts due under this Agreement, are not damages for purposes of the foregoing cap.
